connections.cliHint: Runs the official CLI installed and signed in on this PC as is. Set the default model and effort here.
connections.apiKeyHint: Calls the API directly without the CLI.
connections.pairHint: Opens this PC so you can chat with its CLI from your phone or the web.
connections.bridgeHint: Connects this app to the remote pairing another PC has opened.

device.apiKeyHint: Study data is saved on this device, and replies come directly from the API.
device.switchHint: Pick a PC to see its study data and get replies from its CLI. The app restarts.

general.defaultProviderHint: Used for new sessions and sessions without a provider set.
general.fallbackOrderHint: If the current provider is offline, connections are suggested in this order.
general.contextLabel: Context: last {count} messages from the parent chat
general.contextLabel_one: Context: last {count} message from the parent chat
general.contextHint: Number of recent messages from the parent session to send with a branch question.

screen.anchorTarget: Where to open branches (tablet and desktop)
screen.anchorTargetHint: On mobile, they always open as a bottom sheet.

remote.pcHint: This device shows the PC's study content and sends your questions to the PC. Replies are made by the PC's CLI. To use it without a PC, choose this device under [Change profile] below the sidebar.
remote.pairStep1: On the PC, open the octobooks app and turn on Settings → Connections → [Open remote pairing].
remote.pairStep2: Tap [Connect phone or web] to show a QR code and a 6-digit code.
remote.pairStep3: Below, scan the QR code or enter the link or address and the code.
remote.unpairMessage: The PC's study content stays as it is. This PC is also removed from your saved list, and to use it again you need a new pairing code from the PC.
remote.offline: Couldn't connect to the PC. Check that the PC app is running and remote pairing is turned on.
remote.unsupported: The octobooks app on the PC doesn't support remote study. Update the PC app to the latest version.
remote.codeTrust: · Connected with a code. Check that it matches the fingerprint on the PC screen.
remote.oldHint: There are {count} study items saved on this {device}. They aren't shown while you're viewing the PC.
remote.oldHint_one: There is {count} study item saved on this {device}. It isn't shown while you're viewing the PC.
remote.exported: Exported to a file. You can move it to the PC app with Settings → Backup → [Import file].
remote.note1: Study records are saved only on the PC, and this device shows the PC's content while it's connected.
remote.note2: Questions, branches, and summaries are sent to the PC, and replies are made by the official CLI signed in on the PC. You can change the agent, model, and effort from the chips above the chat. If left empty, the PC settings apply.
remote.note3: Replies in progress and summary drafts on the PC are shown here too. You can view them on the PC and this device at the same time.
remote.note4: The connection is signed with device keys and end-to-end encrypted. Content isn't visible even when it passes through the relay.

voice.inputHintRemote: When you speak with the mic in the input box, the connected PC turns it into text. Settings changed here apply to the PC and every device connected to it.
voice.inputHintLocal: When you speak with the mic in the input box, this PC turns it into text. Recordings are not sent over the internet and are deleted right after conversion.
voice.readyRemote: Ready to use. Tap the mic in the input box.
voice.readyLocal: Ready to use. Connected phones and the web can use it too.
voice.engineMissingRemote: The voice engine (whisper-cli) is missing on the PC. Reinstall the PC app, or install it from the PC's terminal with {code}.
voice.engineMissingLocal: The voice engine (whisper-cli) is missing. Reinstall the app, or install it from the terminal with {code}.
voice.modelHintRemote: Download it to the PC once and keep using it. Even if you close this screen while downloading, the PC keeps downloading.
voice.modelHintLocal: Download once and keep using it on this PC. Choose the model to use.
voice.followPcOffline: Follows the PC settings. Once connected to the PC, you can turn it on and download models here.
voice.unsupportedPc: This PC doesn't support voice input yet. Update the PC app or the octobooks server to use it.
voice.updatePcHint: Follows the PC settings. Update the PC app to change it here too.
voice.offOnPc: Voice input is turned off on the PC.

selectionTrigger.label: Text drag menu
selectionTrigger.hintAuto: Drag text in a reply and the branch and format menu appears right away. On narrow screens (mobile width) it is always automatic.
selectionTrigger.hintContextmenu: After dragging, right-click to open the menu. A plain drag only does the basic action, such as copy.

autoSkill.label: Automatically use skills that fit the request
autoSkill.hintOn: When you ask something that matches a skill, like "Give me a quiz" or "Read the pronunciation," the skill is attached to the input automatically. Remove it with the ✕ on the chip to skip it for this question only.
autoSkill.hintOff: Skills are only used when you pick them with the / command or the + menu.

appearance.sectionHint: Pick a color that suits today's learning. It applies to this device only.
appearance.quote: In any sea, your curiosity keeps reaching outward.

speech.title: Read aloud
speech.hint: Select text in a reply and press [Listen] to hear it. Vietnamese, English, and Korean are picked automatically. Saved on this device only.
speech.engineDeviceHint: Reads with the voices built into the device. Free, and works without internet. Accents follow the voices installed on the device.
speech.engineOpenaiHint: Reads with OpenAI voices. If the key is missing, the usage limit is reached, or the connection fails, the device voice reads instead.
speech.modelHint: Shared setting. The tts-1 models do not take accent or tone instructions.
speech.openaiVoiceHint: Uses only the selected voice. Hearing the same text again plays the saved audio.
speech.accentNote: The current model (tts-1 family) does not take accent instructions. To change the accent, choose gpt-4o-mini-tts.
speech.viAccentHint: The north reads in the Hanoi standard accent, and the south in the Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon) accent.
speech.koNote: Korean is read in clear standard speech.
speech.keySavedLocal: Saved ({key}) · Same as the OpenAI key in the Connections tab.
speech.keyMissing: Without a key, the device voice reads instead.
speech.keyMissingWeb: Without a key, the device voice reads instead. On the web, the key is erased when the tab closes.

host.summaryClosed: Turn it on to view this PC's learning and ask questions from your phone or the web.
host.modelNote: The model and effort follow the defaults on the CLI cards above and cannot be changed from your phone or the web.
host.deleteHint: When off, sessions, branches, and questions cannot be deleted from your phone or the web.
host.qrScan: Scan the QR with your phone or enter the code
host.noAddress: No address is reachable from outside. Connect to the same Wi‑Fi or Tailscale, or set up a relay.
host.fingerprint: This PC's fingerprint {fp}. When connecting by code, check that it matches the fingerprint shown on your phone.
host.relayHint: When you're not on the same network or Tailscale, traffic is relayed through a relay server. Content is end-to-end encrypted and cannot be read by the relay.

card.cliOffline: Can't connect to the CLI process. Restart the app or check the bridge.
card.cliReady: Tools disabled · each request runs stateless
card.invalidModel: Only letters, numbers, and . _ - : / [ ] are allowed.
card.effortHint: You can change it per conversation below the chat input.
card.keyUnverified: Key saved, but could not be verified: {message}
card.modelFixed: Model {model} (default fixed · the model can be chosen in the PC app)
card.keyOsNote: The key is encrypted and stored in this device's OS secure storage.
card.keyMemoryNative: The OS secure storage is unavailable on this device, so the key is kept in memory only. It is erased when the app reopens.
card.keyMemoryWeb: On the web, the key is kept only in this tab's memory and erased on refresh. The desktop and mobile apps save it to the OS secure storage.
card.webKeyNote: On the web, the device key is kept only in this tab's memory, so you must pair again after a refresh.
card.mockBridgeDetail: MacBook-Pro · Direct LAN connection · 18 ms latency
card.pairFailed: Couldn't pair. Check that remote pairing is open in the PC app.
card.scanInvalid: This isn't an octobooks pairing QR. Scan the [Connect phone or web] screen in the PC app.
card.linkHint: Use [Scan QR] to scan the QR on the PC screen, or paste the link shown.
card.linkHintScan: Scan the QR on the PC screen with your phone camera, or paste the link shown.
card.linkInvalid: Paste the pairing link that starts with branch://pair as is.
card.codeHint: Enter the address and 6-digit code shown on the PC screen.
card.cameraFailed: Couldn't open the camera. Allow camera access in Settings.
card.oneTimeNote: The one-time code expires after 5 minutes. The connection is signed with the device key and end-to-end encrypted.
card.codeTrust: · Connected by code. Check that it matches the fingerprint on the PC screen.
card.policy1: Subscription accounts connect only by running the official CLI that you installed and signed in to.
card.policy2: The app does not read or copy login token files, and does not imitate client headers.
card.policy3: The app keeps conversation history and branch context. The CLI runs fresh for each request (tools disabled, read-only).
card.policy4: When remote pairing is open, requests from paired devices also run on this PC's CLI. The agent, model, and effort follow this PC's settings by default, and a paired device can change them per chat among this PC's CLIs.
card.bridgeIntro: Connect with the QR link, or the address and code, shown after you turn on [Open remote pairing] in octobooks on another PC.

backup.what: Saves conversations, branches, anchors, summaries, and view state in one file.
backup.locationHint: If several locations are on, the backup is saved to all of them. These are point-in-time copies, not live sync.
backup.driveNote: Only accesses the app's hidden folder. Other Drive files can't be seen.
backup.githubNote: Commits backup.json and a readable Markdown file.
backup.autoHint: On change: saves a few minutes after editing stops.
backup.encryptHint: The backup file is encrypted on this device before it's exported.
backup.passWarn: If you forget the passphrase, the backup can't be restored. The passphrase is not stored.
backup.secretsNote: API keys, pairing keys, and login tokens are not included in backups. On the web, Drive and GitHub connections are also kept only in this tab's memory.
backup.tokenHint: Use a fine-grained token that has Contents read/write access to this one repository only.
backup.noBackups: No backups yet. Back up now or import from a file.
backup.entryPassAria: Passphrase of the backup to restore
backup.mergeHint: For the same session, the most recently edited version is kept, and missing sessions are added.
backup.replaceHint: Replaces all conversations on this device with the backup's contents.
backup.restoreNote: {change} The current state is backed up automatically before restoring.
